table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	RowID,
	Date,
	PatientCode,
	RegNo = (SELECT P.RegNo FROM Patient P WHERE HPC.PatientCode=P.PatientCode),
	PatientName = (SELECT P.Name FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode = HPC.PatientCode),
	FHName = (SELECT P.FName FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode = HPC.PatientCode),
	Age = (SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(P.AgeYears))) + ' yrs ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(P.AgeMonths))) + ' mon ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(P.AgeDays))) + ' days ' FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode = HPC.PatientCode),
	Gender = (SELECT P.Gender FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode = HPC.PatientCode),
	AdmissionCode,
	HPC_ChestPain, 
	HPC_ChestpainSince, 
	HPC_ChestPainTimeUnit,
	HPC_ChestPainOnExertion, 
	HPC_ChestPainOnExertionSince,

	HPC_ShortnessofBreathOnExertionSince,

	HPC_ShortnessofBreathAssWithNausia, 
	HPC_ShortnessofBreathAssWithVomitting, 
	HPC_ShortnessofBreathAssWithSweating, 
	HPC_ShortnessofBreathAssWithPalpitations, 
	HPC_ShortnessofBreathAssWithSuffocation, 
	HPC_SyncopeWithHOFall, 
	HPC_SyncopeWithHOFallSince,
	HPC_SyncopeWithHOFallTimeUnit,

	HPC_OtherComplaints,
	UserCode,
	AttendingDoctCode
FROM 
	HPC
WHERE 
	AdmissionCode = :ai_code
ORDER BY
	PatientCode, RowID DESC
